title: 2026 Senate: a state-level regression forecast
text:
NoteReal data



Features come from the Cooperative Election Study (CES, 2016-2024) and the Census ACS 5-year estimates. Targets are CES pre-election Senate intent; accuracy is also checked against certified results from the MIT Election Lab. No 2026 survey exists, so 2026 features carry the 2024 profiles forward.
